title: Prove five-call optimum for three GL2 swaps at scalar-rank cap two
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof: three independent GL2 coordinate-SWAP targets have exact minimum five invocations when each paid a/b call has scalar rank at most two. The complete endpoint restores every additional dirty register. The new diagonal support schedule attains the inherited nine-unit rank lower bound.

```diff
- disjoint two-role batching plus singleton: 6 invocations
+ changing the shared pair between calls: 5 invocations
+ scalar ranks: 2,2,1,2,2; total rank: 9
```

For rank prices `0 <= c1 <= c2 <= 2*c1`, the exact bill is `c1+4*c2`, compared with `3*c1+3*c2` for disjoint batching. The saving is `2*c1-c2`. The theorem holds for every finite register count at least three, with free scalar mixing, and even allows arbitrary binary scalar couplings. The attaining calls are idempotents.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. David Arias #2738 supplies the cited rank-priced Coxeter bound; Ross Richardson #1989/#2415 supplies the cut theorem, GL2 bridge and changed-price handoff. Arham Tahir #1919 supplies the related UT3 batching precedent; Ali Romman #5031 retains the rank-one mixed-block tariff. The new result is the displayed GL2 schedule and its sharp cap-two price consequence, with all predecessor notices unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: fixed disjoint batching uses three rank-two plus three rank-one calls.
- After: the new five-call formal word gives `aba, aba, bab` on the three target roles and identity on every spectator. No extra role, scalar bridge or cleanup is needed.
- Both exact representations pass 236 gauged complete endpoints, including 5,172 regular-action basis columns. Both reject every one of 1,180 call omissions; the formal checks also reject 1,180 label flips, 68 dirty-coupling faults and a rank-three invocation. Exact rational price checks cover 65 cases and 9,360 bounded integer-profile comparisons.
- Normal and optimized direct commands pass, timed locally at 0.473s and 0.472s. The registered package replay takes 1.267s. Development-mode warning-strict execution, semantic formal/regular/price mutations and receipt-corruption controls pass.
- Exact committed-byte/source-history checks and official six-file export integrity pass. Normal and optimized direct replay pass from a read-only Git-free export. No predecessor scientific replay is run.

Reproduce from the repository root with CPython 3.12.15 and the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank2-swap-batching
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/rank2-swap-batching/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/rank2-swap-batching/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rank2-swap-batching --check-source-history
```

Expected: `PASS_RANK2_SWAP_BATCHING minimum=5 rank_profile=2,2,1,2,2 rank_mass=9 no_new_kappa`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Other installations may substitute their CPython 3.12 executable. The generated receipt binds the exact package sources.

## Limitations

This is a formal group-algebra construction and exact tariff, not a native supplier or a complete multiplication theorem. Scalar projector rank is not recursive child rank. Native compilation, physical data layout, ownership, routing, precision, stock, tape and a complete recursive invoice remain unknown. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and the selected cold replay are unrun; the selected frontier is unchanged. The rank lower bound is a cited predecessor premise, not newly verified here.

Scientific base: `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`. Submission refresh fetched main `9269eea18a6a10dddeac6a4f696904c55ef1d365`; guidance, selected record and relevant predecessor paths were unchanged. Immutable pins retain the scientific base.

[Canonical CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19141448).

## Open next questions

- Can a native implementation supply this exact cap-two invocation at a strictly subadditive complete price? Start with its explicit arbitrary-input layout and entry/exit contract, then price all adapters and cleanup. No such physical contract is supplied here.
- What is the exact three-target tariff with ranks above two? Start with one declared full price schedule and complete endpoints; the inherited rank floor alone does not establish attainment.

## Related open work

- #2444 studies formal GL2 rank-one five-SWAP words and exact-search infrastructure. It explicitly excludes rank-two unit prices from its scope; this PR constructs a three-SWAP word in that changed-price model and does not replay its census.

The later open contributions #5080 (degree-controlled cyclic inverse constants), #5084 (norm-six dyadic compression) and #5085 (partial Pauli transvections) concern different objects and quantities. None supplies a competing cap-two GL2 SWAP tariff, and no numerical comparison is asserted.

Blast radius: package. No shared source, frozen evidence or selected certificate changes.
